snippet.title: Mana Blast (Event Version) Stages 1 ~ 2 (Ritear)
snippet.description:
Site: http://www.7-iro.org/game/manablast/

I got this game along with another one of the same author during Comiket 77 although it wasn't officially released there but a bit earlier in 2009.

You can retrieve a web version (which I think lets you play up to stage 5) and all the graphic materials used for the game, which are an excellent reference on how to make textures and stuff if you plan to make a shooting game, especially because the game uses several effects to give a 3D feeling on the backgrounds but it's still in 2D. BGM is not available though, and it's a pity: some of the tunes are great.

The game is quite inspired by Hellsinker and Diadra Empty, which is no wonder because the author knows the developers of both games. Thus, you'll see a mix of mechanical and human enemies and some hints to Hellsinker's Kagura in the shape of the bullet-clearing laser and the energy sword used by another character, which in turn is a Radiant Silvergun trait.

Ok, not much to say beside that this game is HARD. It gets HARD (in caps). Not CAVE hard but the barrages strike at you without mercy and at full speed. Forget of slow patterns, the "Blast" in Mana Blast is there for something: you either kill or be killed. The Mana bar allows you to release a "Blast" that'll cancel out all bullets on screen while dealing massive damage to the enemies. Using this as a "counter" for incredibly fast and impossible to dodge barrages is essential, just like using the charge shots to cancel out bullets and survive enemies trying to ram at you like mad.

So far so good. It gets terrible later on, you'll see.
